name: product-legal
description: Product launch reviews, marketing claims clearance, feature legal triage, and terms of service analysis for product and growth teams.
author: Anthropic

skills.name: cold-start-interview
skills.description: Initial practice profile setup — learns your product lines, regulated verticals, and review cadence in 10-15 minutes

skills.name: launch-review
skills.description: Run a structured legal checklist against a new product or feature before launch

skills.name: marketing-claims-review
skills.description: Evaluate advertising copy, landing pages, and email campaigns for FTC compliance, substantiation, and jurisdiction-specific rules

skills.name: feature-triage
skills.description: Quick legal-risk triage for a described feature or product change — flags regulated areas and recommends next steps

skills.name: tos-review
skills.description: Review or draft terms of service, end-user license agreements, and acceptable use policies
